text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the mile, Yamanin Zephyr 
conquered the sprint division. All that 
remained to achieve the "Three-Division 
Sweep" was to win the medium-distance 
Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr attempts a feat that even 
the "Emperor of the Mile" could not 
achieve. Her Trainer wishes to be of even 
more help to her—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A joint training session has been arranged 
with the Umamusume scheduled to run in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr thanked her Trainer for all 
their hard work... and began her final 
push toward her next goal, the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).
